lines.en: - Ron, did you get my texts? - No.
- Did you get my emails? - Mm-mm.
- Did you see that I paged you? - I did not.
- Did you check your voicemail? - I didn't.
- We have a criminal emergency in our hands.
Someone planted a gateway drug in the community garden.
- Okay, call the cops. - That'll leak to the press.
and they'll find my fingerprints on the manure,
and then we'll lose our funding.
- You don't have funding. - And we never will.
If this gets out, look, I will call the cops,
but just give me one day to deal with this internally, okay?
And listen, if this thing blows up, I was never here.
I've had it for a while,
and I've been ignoring it successfully,
But as long as I sit still
- Get my lunch for me, please.
- Is this some kind of weird power trip?
- I went home, but I had this strange feeling
that there was something wrong with you,
- It's just a minor medical issue.
- Is it like a parasite or a virus
or something you get from a bee?
It's possible to have two things.
Do you need a ride to the hospital?
But I rode my bike here,
so I have to go home
and get my dad's station wagon.
I just wanted to see if you could tell.
I had to wait till my dad fell asleep
so I could steal his keys.
